source_notes.title: 26.07.15 주경민, cell heating 이후 RF sensitivity 변화양상 확인
source_notes.note: The presentation is contextual evidence only; it is not embedded or parsed by this example workflow.
GABES implements the first-order finite-IF weak-SIG Liouvillian response; full time-domain LO+SIG/lock-in processing remains deliberately deferred.
The default 1326.257 e a0 is the ARC 3.10.2 stretched-state sigma+ matrix element; angular factor and detector throughput remain explicit assumptions.

inputs.note: Export the original detuning-signal traces to a clean long-form CSV before enabling this input.
Use MEASURED for values recomputed from raw traces; use PPT for manual slide transcription.
Prefer both heater sensors and an independently justified cold-spot temperature.
